name: go
description: Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring Go packages, error handling, interfaces, concurrency, or project layout. Use for Go idioms, package organization, testing patterns, and version-gated features. Not for CLI framework setup (use cobra-viper), release mechanics (use go-release), spec review (use go-spec-reviewer), desktop apps (use wails), or file operations on untrusted paths (use fileflow-pathologize). current through Go 1.27.
